args.title: Modify error toasts to use assertive aria-live and remain until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

To improve accessibility, change error toasts to have an 'aria-live' attribute value of 'assertive', ensuring that screen readers announce them immediately. Additionally, modify error toasts so that they do not automatically disappear after five seconds, but instead remain visible until the user dismisses them.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use 'assertive' for 'aria-live' to ensure they are announced immediately, and they should remain visible until dismissed instead of auto-dismissing after five seconds.
